verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a government immigration service could offer account-free or file-number entry into its online application flow. The evidence pack does not document one. The only keyless items are an eligibility questionnaire and a public processing-times checker, which sit beside the core filing flow rather than inside it. The status-check link does not say whether an account is needed, and the homepage points users to accounts (GCKey).

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
